messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell healthcare professional if breastfeeding or planning to breastfeed"
set: ["tell healthcare professional if breastfeeding or planning to breastfeed", "tell healthcare professional if pregnant or planning to become pregnant", "tell doctor if breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed", "talk to healthcare provider if breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed", "breastfeeding or intending to breastfeed", "inform doctor if pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding", "intravenous by healthcare professional", "tell doctor if planning surgery", "tell doctor if pregnant or planning pregnancy", "tell doctor if are breastfeeding", "inform healthcare provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy", "inform doctor or pharmacist if pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding", "muscle injection by healthcare professional", "tell healthcare team if planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation", "tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding", "decide with healthcare provider whether to take medicine or breastfeed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "tell doctor if breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed",

  ],
  "alias": "tell healthcare professional if breastfeeding or planning to breastfeed"
}
